name: Nature Spirit Base
notes: Chassis for Nature Spirits: place-bound guardian beings tied to a specific natural seat (grove, spring, hill, marsh, etc.). Provides identity Tags and Traits. Domain / Motivation / Loadout / Quirk ChangeSets layer on top to specialise the spirit.
description: It is tied to a natural seat such as a grove, spring, stone, marsh, or cliff, and is strongest when acting through or within that place. It notices and reacts when its place is violated, neglected, polluted, despoiled, or treated without proper respect, and may answer respect with aid or trespass with warning, misdirection, or death. It can seem beautiful, monstrous, half-seen, or wholly natural until it chooses to reveal that the place itself is watching. Grants: Call of the Place, Grasp of Root and Stone, Slip Into the Land, Blessing of the Place. Natural grants: Claws (Medium) + Natural Armor (Medium).

name: Beast Base
notes: Chassis for Beasts: dangerous natural animals (wolves, bears, boars, great cats, etc.) driven by hunger, fear, territory, or pack instinct. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Pack-Hunter / Brute-Predator / Ambush-Hunter / Scavenger ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.
description: This is a living animal shaped by body, instinct, and environment rather than by glamour, curse, or mythic office. It relies on scent, hearing, movement, and instinctive awareness to track danger, prey, or intrusion. It attacks with bite, claw, horn, tusk, trampling force, or other natural weaponry rather than crafted arms. Grants: Savage Rush, Maul, Break Away. Natural grants: Claws (Medium) + Bite (Medium) + Natural Armor (Medium).

name: Hidden Folk Base
notes: Chassis for Hidden Folk: elder parallel people occupying the land beside humanity, dangerous through glamour, influence, and folklore-law rather than violence. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Hill / Hearth / Wood / Water ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.
description: The being is difficult to clearly make out because it dwells partly in hidden parallel to ordinary human sight, revealing itself only by choice, pressure, or failure of concealment. It reacts strongly to trespass, insult, theft, broken hospitality, oath-breaking, and other violations of the older rules by which its people deal with the world. It belongs to an older hidden people that still occupies the land beside humanity, with pride, memory, and purposes that do not center human needs. Grants: Brush of Glamour, Cold Hand, Slip Aside.

name: Undead Base
notes: Chassis for Undead: beings that failed to pass out of the world in death (revenants, draugr, ghosts, hauntings, fetches, etc.). Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Restless / Ghost / Unquiet / Living-Dead / Haunting / Fetch ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.
description: It did not pass properly out of the world. Whether corpse, spirit, echo, or false continuation, it remains because death was denied, disrupted, or refused. Its continued presence is anchored in hatred, grief, injustice, oath, wrong burial, unclean spirit, magic, or some other unresolved cause that gives shape to its return. Its presence brings dread, chill, sorrow, sacrilege, corruption, or the sense that something about death has gone uncleanly wrong. Grants: Return Unbidden, Touch of the Grave, Presence of the Unquiet. Natural grants: Claws (Medium) + Bite (Medium) + Natural Armor (Medium).

name: The Unseen Base
notes: Chassis for The Unseen: singular elder powers of the Hidden Folk civilization (Jinn, Lady of the Lake, Sidhe nobles, Erlking, Frau Holle, Wild Hunt leaders). Provides identity Tags and Traits plus four default powers. Courtly / Water Sovereign / Winter Matron / Hunt Master / Smokeless Fire ChangeSets layer on top.
description: This is not an ordinary hidden creature but one of the elder great beings of the parallel civilization, set apart by age, magical force, and consequence. Mortals and lesser Hidden Folk alike feel awe, fascination, pressure, or terror in its presence even when it is calm. Bargains, names, invitations, thresholds, oaths, and older hidden obligations carry real force when dealing with it. Prolonged contact with the being disturbs mortal judgment, fortune, sleep, piety, or allegiance, and concealment is less reliable before it. Grants: Sovereign Presence, Word of Binding, Pass Unbarred, Bestow or Withhold. Natural grants: Claws (Medium).

name: Unnatural Base
notes: Chassis for Unnaturals: outsider entities (devils, demons, angels, soul-drinkers, possessors, messengers) from another existence brought into the world by summoning, breach, invitation, or unlawful passage. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Angelic / Infernal / Demonic / Tempter / Possessor / Familiar / Soul Drinker / Messenger / Commander ChangeSets layer on top.
description: It is not merely strange, foreign, or magical, but a being from another existence brought or loosed into the world by summoning, breach, invitation, or unlawful passage. Its presence brings temptation, dread, zeal, condemnation, or spiritual pressure because every encounter with it is entangled in a larger factional struggle for souls, service, and allegiance. It is not merely capricious. Even when seductive, merciful, or destructive, it acts under a factional order of rank, doctrine, command, or appetite that reaches beyond the mortal world. Grants: Presence of the Outer War, Word of Temptation or Command, Enter Unbidden. Natural grants: Claws (Medium) + Tentacle (Medium) + Natural Armor (Medium).

name: Construct Base
notes: Chassis for Constructs: made beings (golems, homunculi, animated guardians, laboratory things, crafted servitors) given force, motion, and purpose by human or nonhuman craft. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Golem / Homunculus / Brazen Head / Wax Servitor Domain ChangeSets layer on top.
description: It is a fabricated being, produced by hands, tools, formulae, rite, or inscription rather than by ordinary generation. It is driven by command, inscription, design, or imprinted labor rather than by ordinary appetite, fear, kinship, or ambition. Its body bears force as crafted matter, stitched form, animated material, or reinforced shell rather than as ordinary flesh alone. Grants: Obey the Imprint, Crafted Strike, Tireless Function. Natural grants: Natural Armor (Medium).

name: Colossus Base
notes: Chassis for Colossi: rare immense beings (dragons, kraken, leviathans) defined by overwhelming scale, force, dormancy, hunger, and catastrophic presence. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Dragon / Sea Colossus / Abyssal / Ancient Cunning ChangeSets layer on top.
description: Its body is so large that movement, presence, and simple force can break lines, crush obstacles, capsize vessels, or dominate ordinary creatures. It can absorb punishment that would stop ordinary creatures, and lesser blows may matter more as irritation than injury unless they are well-placed, blessed, or desperate. It spends long stretches in sleep, depth, lair, or half-waking stillness, but once stirred, starved, or roused, it moves with the terrible simplicity of a feeding catastrophe. Grants: Crushing Advance, Titanic Blow, Roar or Surge of Dread. Natural grants: Claws (Large) + Bite (Large) + Natural Armor (Large).

name: Zone Base
notes: Chassis for Zone creatures: eerie stalking beings tied to warped pockets of reality, known more by signs and partial glimpses than clear sight. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Manifestation / Echo Person / Zone Predator / Warped Servitor / Boundary Haunter ChangeSets layer on top.
description: It is usually known through movement, traces, peripheral glimpses, or the certainty that something is there rather than through clear observation. It follows, circles, separates, and pressures intruders with patience, using the wrongness of the Zone as part of the hunt. It belongs to warped terrain, wrong silence, broken paths, impossible nearness, and the hostile logic of the Zone rather than to any stable natural, supernatural, or historical order. Grants: Stalking Pressure, Lead From the Path, Sudden Taking.

name: People Base
notes: Chassis for People: human opposition built as monster archetypes (guards, commoners, men-at-arms, knights, raiders) rather than full PC sheets. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Commoner / Guard / Raider / Man-at-Arms / Knight ChangeSets layer on top.
description: This is a human being shaped by ordinary needs, loyalties, fear, training, and social position rather than by monstrous or supernatural nature. The person is understandable in human terms: they answer to custom, fear, pay, hunger, faith, authority, kinship, and immediate danger. The person can stand, panic, retreat, or break depending on pressure, leadership, injury, and what they believe they are facing. Grants: Press the Fight, Armed Strike, Fall Back or Hold. Natural grants: Unarmed.

name: Natural Weapons
notes: Loadout (universal): Tusks + Horn — adds gore/ramming weapons on top of any chassis. Variety pack for monsters that don't natively have horns or tusks.
description: Bestial protrusions for goring and ramming attacks. Useful for boars, oxen, rhinos, or anything horned and dangerous. Grants: Tusks (Medium), Horn (Medium).

name: Heavy Body
notes: Quirk (universal, body-shape): Heavy Body. +1 Strength, grants Drag Down.
description: Corpse-mass, grave weight, or catastrophic bulk that crushes by mere arrival. (Strength +1) Grants: Drag Down.

name: Armed
notes: Loadout (universal): Armed — carries weapons. Grants Shield Bash.
description: Practical weapons, discipline, and ordinary human combat readiness. Grants: Arming Sword.

name: Armored
notes: Loadout (universal): Armored. Grants Brace Behind Armor.
description: Plated, mailed, or harnessed body designed to take blows that would stop the unarmored. Grants: Brigandine.

name: Mounted
notes: Loadout (universal): Mounted. Grants Ride Through.
description: Carried by horse, otherworldly mount, or impossible steed — brings speed and shock to the encounter. Grants: Ride Through.

name: Ranged
notes: Loadout (universal): Ranged — carries a ranged weapon (bow, sling, sting, projector). Grants Loose the Shot.
description: Bows, crossbows, stones, or thrown weapons handled by mortal skill. Grants: Crossbow.

name: Swift Fragile
notes: Quirk (universal, body-shape): Swift Fragile. +1 Dex, grants Slip Past the Gaze.
description: Quick, elusive, half-seen, and hard to pin down. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Slip Past the Gaze.

name: Grasping
notes: Loadout (universal): Grasping (extra limbs, tentacles, clamp-hands). Grants Seize the Living.
description: Hands that take and refuse to release — whether dead grip or built clamp. Grants: Tentacle (Medium).

name: Guardian
notes: Motivation (universal): Guardian — defends place, watch, or charge. Grants Turn Back the Threat.
description: Defends grove, stream, homestead, or sacred patch. Warns before punishing. Grants: Turn Back the Threat.

name: Hunter
notes: Motivation (universal): Hunter — pursues chosen prey by scent, pattern, or pursuit. Grants Follow the Quarry.
description: Prey-driven, instinctive, and physical. Grants: Follow the Quarry.

name: Lurer
notes: Motivation (universal): Lurer — draws victims into bad ground by voice, false welcome, or wrong invitation. Grants Lead to Bad Ground.
description: Misleads threats into water, bog, cold, roots, or getting lost. Grants: Lead to the Bad Ground.

name: Territorial
notes: Motivation (universal): Territorial — drives intruders from claimed ground by threat or force. Grants Drive from the Range.
description: Den, range, young, and feeding ground defense. Grants: Drive from the Range.

name: Vengeful
notes: Motivation (universal): Vengeful — revenge, blood-price, retaliation. The named wrong drives every action. Grants Strike the One Who Caused This.
description: Revenge, blood-price, curse-retaliation, or feud — the named wrong drives every action. Grants: Strike the One Who Caused This.

name: Hungry
notes: Motivation (universal): Hungry — appetite drives action; targets are food first, threat second. Grants Commit to the Kill.
description: Ordinary predation intensified by famine, season, or risk. Grants: Commit to the Kill.

name: Protector of Kin
notes: Protector of Kin — multi-family (People, Beast). Grants Step Between Them.
description: Defends household, kin, mate, young, or pack at personal cost. Grants: Step Between Them.

name: High Drive When Pressed
notes: High Drive When Pressed — multi-family (People, Undead, Unnatural). Drive increases when the central matter is challenged.
description: Drive hardens when the central loyalty, grievance, or mission is directly challenged. Increase Drive in social battles when the matter named is the one that anchors this being.

name: Recruiter
notes: Active pressure to win allegiance rather than merely kill or frighten. Grants Offer the Side.
description: Active pressure to win allegiance — through infernal pact, court invitation, or changeling exchange — rather than merely to kill or frighten. Grants: Offer the Side.

name: Preserve the Hidden Order
notes: Civilizational preservation, magical continuity, harsh judgment toward threats to the hidden order. Grants Command in the Name of the Old Order.
description: Civilizational preservation, magical continuity, and harsh judgment toward threats to the hidden order. Grants: Command in the Name of the Old Order.

name: Await the Summons
notes: Unnatural patience, dormancy, sudden total obedience once triggered. Grants Wake to Command.
description: Unnatural patience, dormancy, and sudden total obedience once triggered. Grants: Wake to Command.

name: Return to the House
notes: Tragic repetition, domestic wrongness, attachment to household identity after death. Grants Resume the Old Habit.
description: Tragic repetition, domestic wrongness, and attachment to a household, kin-place, or wronged hearth — whether by unquiet death or by curse. Grants: Resume the Old Habit.

name: Fulfill the Curse
notes: Inescapable compulsion, recurrence, partial loss of choice under imposed magical fate. Grants The Pattern Repeats.
description: Inescapable compulsion, recurrence, and partial loss of choice under imposed magical fate. Grants: The Pattern Repeats.

name: Manifest the Zone
notes: Not predation alone, but active making-real of warped locality at immense scale. Grants Bring the Wrongness With It.
description: Not predation alone, but active making-real of warped locality at immense scale. Grants: Bring the Wrongness With It.

name: Wood (HiddenFolk)
notes: Elder parallel inhabitants of forest margins and hidden paths. +1 MoveClimb, grants Lead Astray.
description: Elder parallel inhabitants of forest margins and hidden paths. (Climb +1) Grants: Lead Astray.

name: Wood (NatureSpirit)
notes: Skogsra, dryads, wood-wives, grove spirits. +2 MoveClimb, grants Turn the Path.
description: Skogsra, dryads, wood-wives, grove spirits watchful through forest cover. (Climb +2) Grants: Turn the Path.

name: Wood (Beast)
notes: Wolves, boars, bears, dangerous woodland animals. +1 MoveGround, grants Break from the Brush.
description: Natural, territorial, scent-driven, hard to corner in cover. (Move +1) Grants: Break from the Brush.

name: Water (HiddenFolk)
notes: Brook-side and ford-dwelling hidden folk. MoveSwim 5, grants Mirror-Lure.
description: Brook-side and ford-dwelling hidden folk, quick to answer disrespect with magical reprisal. (Swim = 5) Grants: Mirror-Lure.

name: Water (NatureSpirit)
notes: River wives, ford spirits, spring maidens. MoveSwim 6, grants Beckoning Reflection.
description: River wives, ford spirits, spring maidens — inviting and dangerous. (Swim = 6) Grants: Beckoning Reflection.

name: Water (TheUnseen)
notes: Water sovereigns, ford maidens of high rank. MoveSwim 6, grants Drowning Summons.
description: Water sovereigns, ford maidens of high rank, mist-and-depth rulers. (Swim = 6) Grants: Drowning Summons.

name: Water (Colossal)
notes: Leviathans, kraken, immense sea-beasts. MoveSwim 7, grants Break the Hull.
description: Leviathans, kraken, immense sea-beasts whose presence turns water into catastrophe. (Swim = 7) Grants: Break the Hull.

name: Hill (HiddenFolk)
notes: Barrow folk, mound-dwellers, elder hill communities. +1 Faith, grants Barrow Glamour.
description: Barrow folk, mound-dwellers, elder hidden communities of hill and hollow. (Faith +1) Grants: Barrow Glamour.

name: Hill (NatureSpirit)
notes: Hill trolls, cliff-haunters, old stone slope wardens. +1 Faith, grants Old Curse.
description: Hill trolls, cliff-haunters, old stone slope wardens — heavy, enduring, territorial. (Faith +1) Grants: Old Curse.

name: Hearth (HiddenFolk)
notes: Hidden folk pressing close against human hearth, hall, byre, and boundary. +1 Intelligence, grants Household Blessing.
description: Hidden folk whose parallel habitation presses close against human hearth, hall, byre, and boundary. (Intelligence +1) Grants: Household Blessing.

name: Hearth (TheUnseen)
notes: Winter matrons, household judges, domestic sovereign powers. +1 Faith, grants Household Judgment.
description: Winter matrons, household judges, domestic sovereign powers. (Faith +1) Grants: Household Judgment.

name: Settlement (HiddenFolk)
notes: Hidden settlements overlapping roads, holdings, byres, lanes, village edges. +1 Intelligence, grants Spoil the Work.
description: Hidden settlements, routes, and courts overlapping with roads, holdings, byres, lanes, and village edges. (Intelligence +1) Grants: Spoil the Work.

name: Settlement (NatureSpirit)
notes: Tomte-like beings, farmstead guardians, shrine spirits. +1 Faith, grants Blessing of the Holding.
description: Tomte-like beings, farmstead guardians, shrine spirits — protective, local, easily turned dangerous. (Faith +1) Grants: Blessing of the Holding.

name: Settlement (People)
notes: Villagers, guards, thieves, town watch, retainers. +1 Charisma, grants Raise the Alarm.
description: Villagers, guards, thieves, town watch, retainers — socially legible and locally bound. (Charisma +1) Grants: Raise the Alarm.

name: Battlefield (People)
notes: Soldiers, mercenaries, raiders rooted in camp, march, and line of battle. +1 Stamina, grants Advance in Line.
description: Soldiers, mercenaries, raiders, and disciplined armed opposition rooted in camp, march, and line of battle. (Stamina +1) Grants: Advance in Line.

name: Battlefield (Undead)
notes: Battle-dead, execution-dead, dead returning from slaughter fields. +1 Power, grants Rise Among the Fallen.
description: Battle-dead, execution-dead, dead that return from slaughter fields and broken lines. (Power +1) Grants: Rise Among the Fallen.

name: Deep Zone (Zone)
notes: Deep stalkers, manifestations of warped interiors. +1 Power, grants Erase the Track.
description: Deep stalkers, manifestations, and predators of warped interiors where human sense has fully failed. (Power +1) Grants: Erase the Track.

name: Underground
notes: Under-earth hidden folk, chamber-dwellers, tunnel-haunters. +1 Intelligence, grants Call Below.
description: Under-earth dwellers — hidden folk chambers, chthonic place-spirits of root and cavern, tunnel-haunters who keep the roads and halls below the human world. (Intelligence +1) Grants: Call Below.

name: Bog
notes: Mire spirits, marsh-lights, fen wardens. +1 Stamina, grants Mire-Clutch.
description: Mire spirits, marsh-lights, fen wardens, reed and rot beings — and the drowned dead the fen does not give back. (Stamina +1) Grants: Mire-Clutch.

name: Stone
notes: Standing-stone wardens, cave-mouth beings, cairn spirits, stone-bound trolls. +1 Strength, grants Stone-Handed Blow.
description: Standing-stone wardens, cave-mouth beings, cairn spirits, stone-bound trolls, and made figures of stone. (Strength +1) Grants: Stone-Handed Blow.

name: Mountain
notes: Highland spirits, avalanche wardens, summit presences. +3 MoveClimb, grants Avalanche Warning.
description: Highland spirits, avalanche wardens, summit presences, and mountain-scale beings — vast, cold, punishing through height and weather. (Climb +3) Grants: Avalanche Warning.

name: Grave
notes: Revenants, draugr, dead bound to mound, tomb, or churchyard. +1 Faith, grants Rise from the Grave.
description: Revenants, draugr, curse-bound bodies, or beings anchored to mound, tomb, or churchyard. (Faith +1) Grants: Rise from the Grave.

name: Infernal (Unnatural)
notes: Devils, contract-demons, tempters of hierarchy and corruption. +1 Charisma, grants Seal the Bargain.
description: Devils, contract-demons, tempters of hierarchy and corruption. (Charisma +1, Power +1) Grants: Seal the Bargain.

name: Angelic (Unnatural)
notes: Cherubic war-servitors, seraphic messengers, rival faction powers of judgment. +1 Faith, grants Announce the Sentence.
description: Cherubic war-servitors, seraphic messengers, rival faction powers of revelation, judgment, or terrible order. (Faith +1, Power +1) Grants: Announce the Sentence.

name: Border Zone
notes: Threshold stalkers, edge-haunters, wrong things at where the safe world thins. +1 Dexterity, grants Call from the Verge.
description: Threshold stalkers, edge-haunters, wrong things that prey where the safe world thins. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Call from the Verge.

name: Golem (Construct)
notes: Clay guardians, laboring wards, letter-bound protectors. +1 Strength, grants Guard the Threshold.
description: Clay guardians, laboring wards, letter-bound protectors, heavy obedient artifices. (Strength +1, Stamina +1) Grants: Guard the Threshold.

name: Homunculus (Construct)
notes: Alchemical servants, whispering assistants, small artificial life-forms. +1 Dexterity, grants Whispering Service.
description: Alchemical servants, whispering assistants, hidden messengers, small artificial life-forms. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Whispering Service.

name: Courtly
notes: Sidhe nobles, fairy kings/queens, barrow-court royalty. +1 Charisma, grants Courtly Favor.
description: Sidhe nobles, fairy kings and queens, barrow-court royalty, lords and ladies of the hollow hill. (Charisma +1) Grants: Courtly Favor.

name: Hunt
notes: Erlking, leaders of the Wild Hunt, spectral riders of rank. +2 MoveGround, grants Mark the Quarry.
description: Erlking, leaders of the Wild Hunt, spectral riders, and the moving host itself — relentless, hard to flee once marked. (Move +2) Grants: Mark the Quarry.

name: Smokeless Fire (TheUnseen)
notes: Jinn, ruin spirits of rank, beings of heat, smoke, bargain, invisible fire. +1 Power, grants Smoke Passage.
description: Jinn, ruin spirits of rank, beings of heat, smoke, bargain, and invisible fire. (Power +1) Grants: Smoke Passage.

name: Winter
notes: Winter queens, snow matrons, rulers of sleep and harsh blessing. +1 Faith, grants Snow Blessing.
description: Winter queens, snow matrons, rulers of sleep, labor, and harsh blessing. (Faith +1) Grants: Snow Blessing.

name: Half-Seen
notes: Half-Seen — multi-family (HiddenFolk, Zone, TheUnseen). Grants Withdraw from Sight.
description: The being is never fully apprehended at one moment — witnesses get fragments, wrong angles, or terror at the partial glimpse. Grants: Withdraw from Sight.

name: Easily Offended
notes: Easily Offended — multi-family (HiddenFolk, NatureSpirit). Grants Answer the Insult.
description: Insult, broken courtesy, neglect, or trespass call forth quick magical reprisal. Grants: Answer the Insult.

name: Voice Like a Lure
notes: Voice Like a Lure — multi-family (NatureSpirit, Zone). Grants Beckon Across the Edge.
description: A voice that draws the listener the wrong way — toward water, off the path, or into bad following. Grants: Beckon Across the Edge.

name: Smells the Living
notes: Smells the Living — multi-family (Beast, Undead). Grants Follow the Blood-Scent.
description: Awareness of the warm, the breathing, the bleeding — instinctive in the beast, returning hunger in the dead. Grants: Follow the Blood-Scent.

name: Speaks in Bargains
notes: Speaks in Bargains — multi-family (TheUnseen, Unnatural). Grants Name the Price.
description: Approach by trade — gift-for-gift old law for the elder, coercive infernal pact for the outsider; bound through promise. Grants: Name the Price.

name: Protective of Its Own
notes: Protective of Its Own — multi-family (Beast, People). Grants Stand for Their Own.
description: Defends pack, den, household, or kin with sudden explosive force. Grants: Stand for Their Own.

name: Burned by Iron
notes: Burned by Iron — multi-family (HiddenFolk, NatureSpirit, TheUnseen). Grants Recoil from Cold Iron.
description: Cold worked iron acts against the elder, hidden, or place-bound being — recoil, weakness, or check. Grants: Recoil from Cold Iron.

name: Must Be Invited
notes: Must Be Invited — multi-family (HiddenFolk, Unnatural, Undead). Grants Wait Beyond the Door.
description: Cannot pass freely — must be welcomed, named in, or given the threshold by invitation, gift, or breach of courtesy. Grants: Wait Beyond the Door.

name: Cannot Be Fully Seen (Zone)
notes: Cannot Be Fully Seen — Zone variant. Grants Refuse Plain Sight.
description: The zone-being can never be apprehended fully at once. Grants: Refuse Plain Sight.

name: Wrong Reflection
notes: Wrong Reflection — Unnatural variant. Grants Show the Wrong Face.
description: What returns in mirror or water is not what stands. Grants: Show the Wrong Face.

name: Only by Night
notes: Only by Night — Cursed variant. Grants Vanish with the Sun.
description: The beings force lives in darkness; it withdraws by day. Grants: Vanish with the Sun.

name: Bound to the Grave-Gift
notes: Bound to the Grave-Gift — Undead variant. Grants Reclaim the Gift.
description: Tied to a buried item; loses force away from the gift. Grants: Reclaim the Gift.

name: Never Stops Watching (Construct)
notes: Never Stops Watching — Construct variant. Grants Eyes Always Open.
description: The construct does not sleep, blink, or look away. Grants: Eyes Always Open.

name: Too Large for Shelter
notes: Too Large for Shelter — Colossal variant. Grants Wreck the Doorway.
description: Cannot fit inside ordinary buildings; breaks what it enters. Grants: Wreck the Doorway.

name: Strengthens in Moonlight
notes: Strengthens in Moonlight — Cursed variant. Grants Wax with the Moon.
description: Visible increase in force, confidence, or wrongness under night. Grants: Wax with the Moon.

name: Half-Seen Body
notes: Quirk (universal, body-shape): Half-Seen Body. +1 Dex, grants Wear the Veil.
description: The body itself refuses plain sight — witnesses see fragments, wrong angles, and a shape that does not assemble. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Wear the Veil.

name: Impossible Bulk
notes: Quirk (universal, body-shape): Impossible Bulk. +1 Str, grants Loom Over the Ground.
description: Sheer wrong scale — the body is more than the eye can fit at once, and mortals cannot count its parts together. (Strength +1) Grants: Loom Over the Ground.

name: Corpse-Body
notes: Quirk (universal, body-shape): Corpse-Body. +1 Sta, grants Walk With Worse Wounds.
description: Openly a corpse — gaping wounds, slack jaw, exposed bone — yet still walking and still answering blows with more of the same. (Stamina +1) Grants: Walk With Worse Wounds.

name: Winged Horror
notes: Quirk (universal, body-shape): Winged Horror. +2 MoveGround, grants Sweep on Wing.
description: Vast wings carry the catastrophe aloft — shadow over villages, ruinous descent, and weather that turns at its passing. (Move +2) Grants: Sweep on Wing.

name: Sleeps for Generations
notes: Quirk: wakes only once in generations. Grants Slow to Wake.
description: Wakes once in a lifetime or once in an age — when it stirs, the land remembers it for a hundred years. Grants: Slow to Wake.

name: Hoards the Geography
notes: Quirk: body and territory cannot be told apart. Grants Take the Land.
description: Claims hill, river, valley, or shore as part of itself — its body and its territory cannot be reasoned apart. Grants: Take the Land.

name: Return to Old Sleep
notes: Motivation: wants only to return to long sleep. Grants Drag Toward Sleep.
description: Was woken against its will — wishes only to be left to lie down again. Will smash whatever keeps it awake. Grants: Drag Toward Sleep.

name: Storm
notes: Domain: storm-being whose body is in the weather. +1 Power, grants Storm-Fall.
description: The body is in the weather — its arrival is the storm, its passing is the calm, its anger is the lightning. (Power +1) Grants: Storm-Fall.

name: Heard Before Arrival
notes: Quirk: announced by sound before sight. Grants Horn Before the Arrival.
description: Horn, hoof, bell, or wind speaks of it before the eye finds it — by the time it is seen, the chase has begun. Grants: Horn Before the Arrival.

name: Place Rather Than Body
notes: Quirk: cannot be located as a single body. Grants Form as Place.
description: Has no single body to strike — exists as terrain, weather, or host, distributed across the ground it claims. Grants: Form as Place.

name: Marks Witnesses Forever
notes: Quirk: marks witnesses for years. Grants Enduring Mark.
description: Those who see it carry the seeing — wrong dreams, a changed name, a faint sign that other zone-things recognize. Grants: Enduring Mark.

name: Continue the Hunt
notes: Motivation: must continue the hunt; chooses prey from those who watched. Grants Mark for the Chase.
description: Drives the chase forward — the host cannot stop, will not stop, and chooses its prey from those who watched it pass. Grants: Mark for the Chase.

name: Wolf (Beast)
notes: Role: Wolf — pack-hunter beast species. +1 Dexterity, grants Pack-Take-Down.
description: Travels and kills in pack, follows by scent across long distance, brings the kin to the kill. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Pack-Take-Down.

name: Bear (Beast)
notes: Role: Bear — solitary mauler beast species. +1 Strength, grants Maul.
description: Walks alone, defends den and young, and kills with mauling strength rather than speed. (Strength +1) Grants: Bear's Maul.

name: Boar (Beast)
notes: Role: Boar — charging tusk-bearer beast species. +1 Stamina, grants Tusk Gore.
description: Charges in straight lines, drives tusks into what stands in front, hard to turn aside once committed. (Stamina +1) Grants: Tusk Gore.

name: Knight (People)
notes: Role: Knight — sworn fighter of rank. +1 Stamina, grants Hold the Line.
description: Sworn fighter of rank — mounted-capable, armored-by-default, owed respect and owed peril by station. (Stamina +1) Grants: Hold the Line.

name: Soldier (People)
notes: Role: Soldier — drilled mercenary or levy. +1 Dexterity, grants Form on the Captain.
description: Mercenary, levy, or standing fighter — used to discipline, command, and the press of formation. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Form on the Captain.

name: Bandit (People)
notes: Role: Bandit — outlaw, highway robber. +1 Dexterity, grants Strike from the Roadside.
description: Outlaw, brigand, or highwayman — strikes from cover, takes by force or threat, vanishes before answer. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Strike from the Roadside.

name: Peasant (People)
notes: Role: Peasant — rural land-bound commoner. +1 Stamina, grants Stand With the Village.
description: Land-bound farmer, tied to soil, season, and lord — knows the field, the storm, the local saint. (Stamina +1) Grants: Stand With the Village.

name: Commoner (People)
notes: Role: Commoner — urban or town-dweller. +1 Charisma, grants Speak with the Watch.
description: Townsperson, journeyman, day-worker, or burgher — knows the market, the parish, the watch. (Charisma +1) Grants: Speak with the Watch.

name: Small (HiddenFolk)
notes: Role: Small hidden folk — pixies, brownies, kobolds, redcaps. +1 Dex, grants Slip the Hand.
description: Pixies, brownies, kobolds, redcaps — the wee folk who slip behind the chamber-pot and the threshold. Quick, hard to grasp, easy to underestimate. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Slip the Hand.

name: Average (HiddenFolk)
notes: Role: Average-scale hidden folk — gnome, household lord, attendant. +1 Cha, grants Speak as a Folk.
description: Hidden folk of broadly mortal scale — gnomes, household lords, court attendants. Carry themselves more as folk than as wee things. (Charisma +1) Grants: Speak as a Folk.

name: Pristine (NatureSpirit)
notes: Role: Pristine nature spirit — whole bond to place. +1 Faith, grants Renew the Place.
description: Bond to place is whole, healthy, and held — the spirit acts as guardian and answer for its grove, well, or stone. (Faith +1) Grants: Renew the Place.

name: Corrupted (NatureSpirit)
notes: Role: Corrupted nature spirit — poisoned bond. +1 Power, grants Spread the Blight.
description: Bond to place has been blighted — the spirit acts as a wrong answer for its land, spreading the harm rather than mending it. (Power +1) Grants: Spread the Blight.

name: Severed (NatureSpirit)
notes: Role: Severed nature spirit — uprooted, land-lost. +1 Power, grants Wander the Wrong Way.
description: Uprooted, displaced, land-lost — no longer held by the place that once anchored it. Wanders without guardianship. (Power +1) Grants: Wander the Wrong Way.

name: Spirit (Undead)
notes: Role: Spirit undead — wraith, shade, ghost. +1 Power, grants Pass Through Walls.
description: Wraith, shade, ghost — what remains is presence and intent, not flesh. (Power +1) Grants: Pass Through Walls.

name: Corpse (Undead)
notes: Role: Corpse undead — skeleton, revenant, walking dead. +1 Stamina, grants Bear More Wounds Than the Living.
description: Skeleton, revenant, walking corpse — what remains is still bodied, still answering blows with more of the same. (Stamina +1) Grants: Bear More Wounds Than the Living.

name: Restless (Undead)
notes: Role: Restless undead — unquiet, unfinished. +1 Power, grants Will Not Lie Still.
description: Cannot lie still — the dead does not rest until the grievance, debt, or wrong is met. (Power +1) Grants: Will Not Lie Still.

name: Sidhe (TheUnseen)
notes: Role: Sidhe — hidden court of TheUnseen, fae royalty. +1 Cha, grants Speak as the Court.
description: Of the hidden court — close-kin to the hidden folk, of the same Otherworld but at a higher tier of presence and rank. (Charisma +1) Grants: Speak as the Court.

name: Ancient (TheUnseen)
notes: Role: Ancient — primordial outsider, jinn, smokeless fire. +1 Faith, grants Stand Older Than the Place.
description: Older than the hidden courts — jinn, smokeless fire, primordial powers and beings predating the fae cosmology. (Faith +1) Grants: Stand Older Than the Place.

name: Lurker (Zone)
notes: Role: Lurker — small zone-being at threshold and edge. +1 Dex, grants Wait in the Wrong Corner.
description: Small-scale zone-being that lurks at thresholds, edges, and forgotten corners. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Wait in the Wrong Corner.

name: Colossus (Zone)
notes: Role: Colossus — catastrophic-scale zone-being. +1 Strength, grants Loom Across the Field.
description: Zone-being at catastrophic scale — the host as terrain, the storm as a single creature, the plague as a thing too large to flee. (Strength +1) Grants: Loom Across the Field.

name: Cursed
notes: Domain: Cursed — multi-family (Beast, People, Undead). +1 Power, grants Bear the Curse.
description: Bears witchcraft, malediction, or sympathetic harm — carries the consequence visibly, in body, behavior, or sign. (Power +1) Grants: Bear the Curse.

name: Minor (Unnatural)
notes: Role: Minor — imp, wisp, summoned servant. Lesser outsider. +1 Dex, grants Pester the Mortal.
description: Imp, wisp, summoned servant — small in might, useful in number or bargain, often the first sign of a greater presence. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Pester the Mortal.

name: Major (Unnatural)
notes: Role: Major — named outsider, grimoire-listed demon or scriptural angel. +1 Power, grants Exert the Named Power.
description: Greater demon or angel, named in grimoire or scripture — exercises specific powers, brings consequence, holds an office. (Power +1) Grants: Exert the Named Power.

name: Noble (Unnatural)
notes: Role: Noble — marquis, duke, count, principality. Court-rank outsider with retinue. +1 Cha, grants Command the Lesser.
description: Marquis, duke, count, or principality — outsider of court rank, bearing retinue, rights, and the authority to bind lesser kin. (Charisma +1) Grants: Command the Lesser.

name: Prince (Unnatural)
notes: Role: Prince — outsider royalty, king, arch-power. Highest office of the outsider hierarchy. +1 Faith, grants Issue the Decree.
description: Prince, king, or arch-power — the highest office of the outsider hierarchy, bearing the crown of their own cosmology. (Faith +1) Grants: Issue the Decree.

name: Veteran (People)
notes: Role: Veteran — war-hardened person, knows what's coming. +1 Power, grants Read the Fight.
description: Has seen the killing, the burning, the breaking — knows what is coming before it lands, and where to stand. (Power +1) Grants: Read the Fight.

name: Spellcaster
notes: Loadout (universal): Spellcaster — carries spells, grimoire, or wand. Grants Cast the Spoken Work.
description: Wields the work through spoken charm, gesture, or written formula — primary action is the cast. Grants: Cast the Spoken Work.

name: Stealthy
notes: Quirk (universal): Stealthy. +1 Dex, grants Strike Unseen.
description: Moves without sound, strikes from cover, vanishes before answer. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Strike Unseen.

name: Brawler
notes: Loadout (universal): Brawler — bare-hand combat skills and maneuvers. Grants Take Them to the Ground.
description: Fights without weapon or claw — wrestler's grip, hammerblow knuckle, throw and pin. Grants: Throw.

name: Burrower
notes: Quirk (universal): Burrower. +1 Sta, grants Vanish into the Earth.
description: Moves through soil and root as easily as the surface — emerges where it chooses. (Stamina +1) Grants: Vanish into the Earth.

name: Climber
notes: Quirk (universal): Climber. +1 Dex, grants Move Where Others Cannot Follow.
description: Moves along vertical surfaces as easily as the ground — wall, tree, tower-side. (Dexterity +1) Grants: Move Where Others Cannot Follow.

name: Frightening Aspect
notes: Quirk (universal): Frightening Aspect. +1 Pwr, grants Break Their Will.
description: The mere appearance breaks order and nerve — strangers run, allies hesitate. (Power +1) Grants: Break Their Will.

name: Greedy
notes: Motivation (universal): Greedy — hoards trophies, gold, souls. Grants Add to the Hoard.
description: Hoards gold, souls, names, food, or trophies — what is taken is never given back. Grants: Add to the Hoard.

name: Curious
notes: Motivation (universal): Curious — investigates and follows. Grants Follow and Watch.
description: Investigates, follows, lingers — wants to know what mortals are doing here, and why. Grants: Follow and Watch.

name: Bored
notes: Motivation (universal): Bored — wants entertainment. Grants Set the Game.
description: Treats mortals as sport — wants entertainment more than blood, but kills in the seeking. Grants: Set the Game.

name: Servant of a Higher
notes: Motivation (universal): Servant of a Higher. Grants Carry the Order.
description: Bound to serve another — demon, prince, witch, lord — acts on absent orders rather than its own will. Grants: Carry the Order.

name: Collector of Trophies
notes: Motivation (universal): Collector of Trophies. Grants Take the Token.
description: Keeps physical tokens of every kill or meeting — fingers, names, hair, teeth, vows. Grants: Take the Token.

name: Tester
notes: Motivation (universal): Tester — sets riddles, trials, judgment. Grants Set the Test.
description: Sets riddles, trials, or moral tests — judges who passes, punishes who fails. Grants: Set the Test.

name: Mourner
notes: Motivation (universal): Mourner — laments and shares grief. Grants Lay the Grief.
description: Laments something lost — a place, a kin, an age — and inflicts that grief on others. Grants: Lay the Grief.

name: Bound to Place
notes: Motivation (universal): Bound to Place — cannot leave, defends the boundary. Grants Stand the Boundary.
description: Cannot leave — anchored by oath, geis, curse, or older purpose — defends the boundary fiercely. Grants: Stand the Boundary.

name: Cannot Cross Running Water
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Cross Running Water. Grants Pause at the Stream.
description: Ford, stream, or mill-race deny passage — must turn aside or find an unmoving crossing. Grants: Pause at the Stream.

name: Cannot Abide Bells
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Abide Bells. Grants Recoil from the Bell.
description: Church-bell, hand-bell, signal-bell — when rung against the warded being, the sound strikes like blows. Grants: Recoil from the Bell.

name: Cannot Bear Salt
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Bear Salt. Grants Withdraw from the Salt.
description: Salt-line, scattered salt, or thrown handful repels and burns — must withdraw or be harmed. Grants: Withdraw from the Salt.

name: Counts Grain
notes: Quirk (universal): Counts Grain — fae compulsion. Grants Become Caught in the Count.
description: Compulsively counts what is spilled — millet, sand, beads, links of chain — cannot turn aside until done. Grants: Become Caught in the Count.

name: Cannot Lie
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Lie. Grants Bound to the Answer.
description: Must answer plain questions truthfully — though the truth may be turned, partial, or worded to harm. Grants: Bound to the Answer.

name: Cannot Refuse a Bargain
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Refuse a Bargain. Grants Hear the Price.
description: Must hear out any offer, must answer any price named — even when refusal would be wisdom. Grants: Hear the Price.

name: Weakened by Sunlight
notes: Quirk (universal): Weakened by Sunlight. Grants Falter in the Sun.
description: Direct daylight saps strength, presence, and resolve — withdraws to shade by necessity. Grants: Falter in the Sun.

name: Cannot Touch Holy Ground
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Touch Holy Ground. Grants Recoil at the Threshold.
description: Consecrated soil, threshold, or altar denies approach — repelled or burned where contact is forced. Grants: Recoil at the Threshold.

name: Knows Every Witness
notes: Quirk (universal): Knows Every Witness. Grants Find the Old Witness.
description: Remembers and recognizes every mortal that has seen it — even years later, even in a crowd. Grants: Find the Old Witness.

name: Vulnerable to Rowan
notes: Quirk (universal): Vulnerable to Rowan. Grants Recoil from the Rowan.
description: Rowan wood, berries, or branches placed across the path stop progress and burn at contact. Grants: Recoil from the Rowan.

name: Cannot Be Counted
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Be Counted. Grants Slip the Count.
description: Slips numerical record — witnesses cannot agree on what they saw or how many. Grants: Slip the Count.

name: Cannot Speak Its True Name
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Speak Its True Name. Grants Refuse the Name.
description: Must answer to a false name only; the true name will not pass its lips. Grants: Refuse the Name.

name: Must Repeat the Same Path
notes: Quirk (universal): Must Repeat the Same Path. Grants Hold to the Path.
description: Bound to a ritual route — walks the same field, hall, or river-bank, will not deviate. Grants: Hold to the Path.

name: Cannot Refuse a Guest
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Refuse a Guest. Grants Open the Door.
description: Hospitality is binding — must offer shelter, food, or hearing to anyone who asks at the right form. Grants: Open the Door.

name: Cannot Pass a Crossroads
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Pass a Crossroads. Grants Pause at the Crossing.
description: Must pause at any crossroads and answer a question to the four winds before continuing. Grants: Pause at the Crossing.

name: Vulnerable to Fire
notes: Quirk (universal): Vulnerable to Fire. Grants Recoil from the Flame.
description: Flame harms more than mortal flesh would suffer — open fire, lantern, torch. Grants: Recoil from the Flame.

name: Vulnerable to Hazel
notes: Quirk (universal): Vulnerable to Hazel. Grants Recoil from the Hazel.
description: Hazel wand, branch, or rod stops progress and burns at contact. Grants: Recoil from the Hazel.

name: Vulnerable to True Name
notes: Quirk (universal): Vulnerable to True Name. Grants Bound by the Spoken Name.
description: Knowing and speaking the true name binds the being — must answer, must obey. Grants: Bound by the Spoken Name.

name: Vulnerable to Prayer Spoken Aloud
notes: Quirk (universal): Vulnerable to Prayer Spoken Aloud. Grants Wounded by the Word.
description: Devotion-words spoken plain — Pater Noster, Psalm, charm — wound and weaken. Grants: Wounded by the Word.

name: Heals in Moonlight
notes: Quirk (universal): Heals in Moonlight. Grants Mend Under the Moon.
description: Wounds close under moonlight — strength returns where the night-sky reaches. Grants: Mend Under the Moon.

name: Cannot Bleed
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Bleed. Grants Refuse the Bleeding.
description: Wounds do not bleed; what should pour out stays in or comes as something else. Grants: Refuse the Bleeding.

name: Cannot Drown
notes: Quirk (universal): Cannot Drown. Grants Walk Beneath the Water.
description: Water does not take it — sinks if it must, surfaces when it chooses. Grants: Walk Beneath the Water.

name: Frail
notes: Quirk (universal stat-shift): Frail. Stamina -1, Charisma +1.
description: Physically delicate but commanding in presence — looks the part more than fights it. (Charisma +1, Stamina -1)

name: Cunning
notes: Quirk (universal stat-shift): Cunning. Intelligence +1, Strength -1.
description: Clever and observant but no fighter — reads the room better than the blade. (Intelligence +1, Strength -1)

name: Brutal
notes: Quirk (universal stat-shift): Brutal. Strength +1, Charisma -1.
description: Physically formidable but socially repulsive — opens with violence, closes the same way. (Strength +1, Charisma -1)

name: Devout
notes: Quirk (universal stat-shift): Devout. Faith +1, Power -1.
description: Pious in conviction but lacking raw might — turns to scripture and oath before strike. (Faith +1, Power -1)

name: Casts No Shadow
notes: Quirk (universal): Casts No Shadow. Grants Reveal the Tell.
description: Light passes the body without leaving a shadow — visible tell to those who look down. Grants: Reveal the Tell.

name: Dogs Will Not Approach
notes: Quirk (universal): Dogs Will Not Approach. Grants Stir the Beasts.
description: Dogs, horses, cats grow uneasy — refuse to draw near, bark or shy without provocation. Grants: Stir the Beasts.

name: Extra Attack
notes: Quirk (universal): Extra Attack — grants an additional strike per turn.
description: Strikes more than one blow per turn — multiple limbs, frenzied speed, or sheer practice. Grants: Strike Twice.

name: Lonely
notes: Motivation (universal): Lonely — seeks companionship. Grants Take a Companion.
description: Seeks companionship through capture, lure, gift, or theft — the absent kin must be replaced. Grants: Take a Companion.

name: Pilgrim
notes: Motivation (universal): Pilgrim — journeys to a sacred place. Grants Press Toward the Place.
description: Journeys toward a place sacred or significant to it — will not be turned aside long. Grants: Press Toward the Place.

name: Punisher
notes: Motivation (universal): Punisher — enforces a moral rule. Grants Pronounce the Sentence.
description: Enforces a moral rule, often arbitrary and harsh — strikes those who break the rule, ignores those who keep it. Grants: Pronounce the Sentence.

name: Trickster
notes: Motivation (universal): Trickster — mischief for its own sake. Grants Set the Trick.
description: Mischief for its own sake — sets traps, plays tricks, reverses expectations without real malice. Grants: Set the Trick.

name: Wants to End
notes: Motivation (universal): Wants to End — weary, seeks oblivion. Grants Seek the Final Rest.
description: Old, weary, seeks oblivion or release — fights only to delay, and would welcome the final blow. Grants: Seek the Final Rest.

name: Liberator
notes: Motivation (universal): Liberator — frees others from their state. Grants Open the Way.
description: Frees others from their state — curse, mortal body, bondage — by whatever means it deems just. Grants: Open the Way.

name: Maker
notes: Motivation (universal): Maker — compulsively creates. Grants Add to the Work.
description: Compulsively builds, shapes, or creates — alchemist, smith, scribe, weaver — the work is never done. Grants: Add to the Work.

name: Spread the Word
notes: Motivation (universal): Spread the Word — proselytizes for a doctrine. Grants Carry the Doctrine.
description: Proselytizes for a faith, faction, master, or doctrine — wants the message to take root in every listener. Grants: Carry the Doctrine.

name: Seek What Was Lost
notes: Motivation (universal): Seek What Was Lost — quest-driven search. Grants Find the Trail.
description: Quest-driven — searches for an heir, a relic, a place, or a person; every other action serves the search. Grants: Find the Trail.

name: Witness
notes: Motivation (universal): Witness — observes, intervenes when crossed. Grants Note the Crossing.
description: Observes only; intervenes when its rule, vow, or watch is broken — otherwise stands and remembers. Grants: Note the Crossing.

name: Boost: Strength
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): Strengthened. +1 Stats_StrengthMod.
description: Body grows stronger — muscle and bone harden with each trial endured. (Strength +1)

name: Boost: Dexterity
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): Quickened. +1 Stats_DexterityMod.
description: Hands and feet grow surer; reaction sharpens with practice. (Dexterity +1)

name: Boost: Stamina
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): Hardened. +1 Stats_StaminaMod.
description: Wind and constitution improve — takes more to stop the being now. (Stamina +1)

name: Boost: Intelligence
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): Sharpened. +1 Stats_IntelligenceMod.
description: Pattern-sense and recall improve; reads the field faster. (Intelligence +1)

name: Boost: Faith
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): Hallowed. +1 Stats_FaithMod.
description: Inner conviction or otherworldly weight strengthens; harder to break by word or rite. (Faith +1)

name: Boost: Power
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): Made Mighty. +1 Stats_PowerMod.
description: Presence and supernatural force amplify; weighs heavier on those who oppose. (Power +1)

name: Boost: Charisma
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): Commanding. +1 Stats_CharismaMod.
description: Voice carries further; eyes find it sooner. (Charisma +1)

name: Boost: Movement
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): Swift-Going. +1 MoveGround.
description: Pace quickens; covers ground others cannot match. (Move +1)

name: Boost: Weapon Die
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): adds a Heavy die to an equipped natural weapon. Rerolled if none equipped.
description: Body-weapon hits harder — an extra Heavy die added to the natural weapon roll.

name: Boost: Armor Die
notes: Boost (universal, stackable): adds an Armor die to equipped natural armor. Rerolled if none equipped.
description: Natural defense hardens — an extra Armor die added to the natural armor.
